help.title: Help & Pilot Guide
help.subtitle: Quick answers for kitchen staff and restaurant managers.
help.q1Title: How do kitchen staff log waste?
help.q1Body: Sign in on the Kitchen Log tab using your Restaurant Code, username, and 4-digit PIN. Pick the wasted item, select the reason (e.g. Over-preparation or Expired), adjust quantity if needed, and tap Log Waste. You can tap Undo immediately if you picked the wrong item.
help.q2Body: If kitchen Wi-Fi drops, waste entries are saved safely inside this browser on your device with a 'Pending sync' badge. Once internet returns, Wafrah syncs queued entries automatically (or tap Sync now) without duplicates.
help.q3Body: Wafrah values each waste entry using your menu item unit cost in SAR and compares weekly waste cost before and after prep recommendations or against baseline averages. Results are operational estimates for management review, not audited accounting figures.
help.q4Title: Who do we contact for support?
help.q4Unconfigured: Pilot support contact has not been configured yet. Please contact the person who onboarded your restaurant.

q1.question: Does Wafrah integrate with Foodics or my current POS?
q1.answer: You can import sales and purchasing reports from any POS (including Foodics or Marn) via CSV today, with automatic Arabic and English item matching. Direct Foodics API integration is on the roadmap.

q2.question: What happens if Wi-Fi drops in the kitchen?
q2.answer: Kitchen logging works offline right in the browser on a phone or tablet. Entries are stored locally on the device and sync automatically as soon as the connection returns.

q3.question: How are estimated SAR savings calculated?
q3.answer: Savings are always shown as an estimate comparing your weekly waste cost against your starting baseline (typically the first 14 days, optionally adjusted for sales volume). Every monthly report displays the exact baseline and calculation method.

q4.question: Do we need special hardware or long staff training?
q4.answer: No new hardware is needed — any mobile phone or tablet works. Kitchen staff unlock the logging screen quickly using your restaurant code, username, and a 4–6 digit PIN.

q5.question: How is our restaurant's data handled?
q5.answer: Each restaurant's operational records are strictly separated per account with role-based access controls. You can review our Privacy Policy page for details on data handling.

q6.question: What are the pilot terms and commitment after the trial?
q6.answer: There is no long-term lock-in required to apply. Exact trial length, onboarding timeline, and post-pilot continuation options are confirmed with you directly when your pilot spot is allocated.
